As clean energy technologies advance at record speed, can our institutions, financing models and energy systems keep pace?

Over the next five years, global electricity demand is expected to grow around 50% faster than it did over the previous decade, driven by electrification, industry, AI and digitalization. Yet financing costs for renewable energy projects remain two to three times higher in many developing economies than in advanced economies. The opportunity to accelerate development through clean energy has never been greater. Delivering on that promise requires faster implementation, stronger institutions and financing that reaches the countries where demand is growing fastest.

Join us today at the 2026 High-level Political Forum on Sustainable Development for a high-level discussion on Accelerating Energy System Innovation and Transition for Equity and Resilience to Advance Global Sustainable Development.

🗓️ 10 July 2026
🕒 3:00–5:30 p.m. (EDT)
📍 ECOSOC Chamber, United Nations Headquarters, New York

Organized by GEIDCO and co-organized by the Permanent Mission of China to the United Nations, UNDP, UNESCAP, UNESCWA, Sustainable Energy for All (SEforALL), and the Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN), the event will bring together senior leaders from across the UN system, governments and international organizations to discuss how innovation, finance, digitalization and partnerships can accelerate progress towards SDG 7.

I look forward to moderating the panel discussion with distinguished speakers from the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), Sustainable Energy for All (SEforALL), UNEP, and the WRI Polsky Energy Center, as we explore practical solutions for accelerating equitable and resilient energy transitions.

If you are in New York, we would be delighted to welcome you in person. The event will also be streamed live on UN Web TV.
